### Summary

::: {.callout-note title="At a glance"}
**What it does.** Says, for each gravity-work form, which energy is exact, per stage or per step, explicit and
implicit, which logged numbers measure it, and which test is its oracle. **Key.** `gravity-work`, default `face`,
with `SNAP_GRAVITY_WORK_RADIAL_EXACT` on by default; `gravity-work-fixer` only with `cell`. **Defining
equation.** @eq-ch06-dwork-booked.
:::

This section describes main at snapy@9ad0936779ae001dba65c9eafccaa7c058686c97, after chengcli/snapy#303; the
rest of the book is pinned at snapy@e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0. Two things changed between the
pins and both matter here. The default of `gravity-work` is now `face`, and with it the corrected-PE face work of
@sec-ch06-dwork, so a deck that omits the key conserves $E+P$, not $E+\mathrm{PE}_d$. And the corrected-PE work
now also runs on `gnomonic-equiangle` (cubed-sphere) grids, where it books one more term for the offset between
the cell's volume centroid and `x1v`.

Every form in this chapter is the identity @eq-ch06-dwork-booked with a different discrete potential energy, so
the question "what does it conserve" is "which $P$ does it use, and where does it stop using it". The face form
uses $P=\mathrm{PE}_d$ everywhere; the corrected-PE work uses the fourth-order $P$ of @eq-ch06-dwork-pe; the cell
form uses none and leaves the defect @eq-ch06-cell-defect, which the fixer removes once per step; `face-wallc`
uses $\mathrm{PE}_d$ except in its two $x_1$ wall cells. The logged `ie=` (total energy) plus `pe=` is the
invariant of the run's own form, because `pe=` logs $P$ whenever the corrected-PE work is active and
$\mathrm{PE}_d$ otherwise. An oracle that checks $E+\mathrm{PE}_d$ on a default run therefore measures the wrong
quantity.

### Derivation

The template @eq-ch06-dwork-booked conserves $E+P$ exactly on a closed column for any $P$; the forms differ only
in $P$, and the derivations are in the sections that own them. The face form is $P=\mathrm{PE}_d$
(@eq-ch06-dwork-face). The corrected-PE work is @eq-ch06-dwork-d, conserving @eq-ch06-dwork-pe; its stage-by-stage
argument extends to the step because $E+P$ is linear in the state and every RK stage is a convex combination
(@sec-ch06-dwork), and in the implicit solve the matrix part @eq-ch06-dwork-couple plus the remainder
@eq-ch06-dwork-remainder book the work of the mass actually moved. The cell form leaves @eq-ch06-cell-defect per
stage; the fixer @eq-ch06-fixer-fix subtracts the stage-weighted sum after the last stage, so $E+\mathrm{PE}_d$
closes per step but not per stage. `face-wallc` books $W^{\mathrm{cell}}$ instead of $W^{\mathrm{face}}$ in the
two $x_1$ wall cells, so its $E+\mathrm{PE}_d$ defect is their cell-minus-face work (@sec-ch06-face).

The one new step at this pin is the cubed-sphere term. On a `gnomonic-equiangle` grid the volume uses the $r^2$
measure, but `x1v` is the cell's face midpoint, not its volume centroid $r_{\mathrm{c},i}$. The fourth-order
expansion of @eq-ch06-dwork-pe4 is about the centroid, so the corrected potential energy is
$P_i = V_i[\rho_i\phi(r_{\mathrm{c},i}) - g_1\sigma_i^2s_i[\rho]]$ with $\sigma_i^2$ about $r_{\mathrm{c},i}$.
Since $\phi(r_{\mathrm{c},i}) = \phi_i - g_1(r_{\mathrm{c},i}-x_{1,i})$, with $\phi_i=-g_1x_{1,i}$ at `x1v`, this
is $P_i = V_i[\rho_i\phi_i - g_1(r_{\mathrm{c},i}-x_{1,i})\rho_i - g_1\sigma_i^2s_i[\rho]]$, and inserting it into
@eq-ch06-dwork-booked, whose face form is written with $\phi_i$ at `x1v`, gives

$$
W_i = W^{\mathrm{face}}_i + g_1\,\sigma_i^2\,s_i[\dot\rho] + g_1\,(r_{\mathrm{c},i}-x_{1,i})\,\dot\rho_i .
$$

The last term is zero on Cartesian and spherical-polar grids, where $r_{\mathrm{c},i}=x_{1,i}$. It is booked by
`corrected_pe_work` under `radial_mid`
([`gravity_work_radial.hpp:94-104`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/9ad0936779ae001dba65c9eafccaa7c058686c97/src/hydro/gravity_work_radial.hpp#L94-L104)),
which is also called for the logged $P$ and the post-solve remainder, and on the diagonal of the implicit energy
row as `rx_mid`
([`implicit_hydro.cpp:317-318`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/9ad0936779ae001dba65c9eafccaa7c058686c97/src/implicit/implicit_hydro.cpp#L317-L318)).
The full derivation is `docs/derivations/curved-gravity-work-weight.md@9ad0936779ae001dba65c9eafccaa7c058686c97`
§12.5a. No executable check of this section's own: each identity it collects is checked by the check of the
section that derives it.

### Numerical method

@tbl-ch06-conserves-summary is the oracle guide. "Stage" means $E+P$ is exact after every RK stage, "step" only
after the whole step. Exact means to round-off on a closed column (reflecting $x_1$ walls); with an open $x_1$
boundary every invariant changes by the potential-energy flux through it, and the fixer refuses that case.

| form | exact invariant | when | logged | oracle |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `cell`, no fixer | none | | `ie=`+`pe=` drifts | `test_gravity_work_fixer_python` |
| `cell` + fixer | $E+\mathrm{PE}_d$ | step, explicit and VIC | `ie=`+`pe=`, `fixgrav=` | `test_gravity_work_fixer_python` |
| `face`, switch 0 | $E+\mathrm{PE}_d$ | stage, explicit and VIC | `ie=`+`pe=` | `test_implicit_face_work_operator_python` |
| `face-wallc` | none in the wall cells | | `ie=`+`pe=` | reported only |
| `face` (default) | $E+P$ | stage, explicit and VIC | `ie=`+`pe=` ($P$) | `test_gravity_work_radial_exact_python` |

: What each form conserves on a closed column, which logged sum measures it and which test checks it. "Switch 0"
is `SNAP_GRAVITY_WORK_RADIAL_EXACT=0`; the default `face` row also holds for grids with no corrected-PE form, as
`face` with switch 0. Tolerances and code links are in the Code and Tests layers. {#tbl-ch06-conserves-summary}

Where each form books its energy: the face form, the corrected-PE term and the cell work are all formed in step
(6) of `HydroImpl::forward`, once per stage, as `gravity_energy_correction`, and added to the energy row before
the implicit solve with `face` and an implicit scheme, after it otherwise (@sec-ch06-dwork). The fixer acts after
the last stage, once per step, so only the step closes under it. With an implicit scheme the VIC carries the
face form and the tridiagonal part of the corrected-PE term in its energy row, and the post-solve remainder books
the rest; under `face-wallc` the face work is swapped in after the solve (@sec-ch06-vic).

Block seams. At an internal $x_1$ seam the explicit corrected-PE work now exchanges one row of the stage's density
change with the $x_1$ neighbour and takes the centred slope a single block would take; at a physical wall the
slope stays one-sided. The logged $P$ does the same with the exchanged ghost density. So a column split in $x_1$
conserves the one-block $P$, and the split state equals the unsplit one. The implicit scheme refuses any $x_1$
split, so the VIC row and its remainder never meet a seam. A periodic $x_1$ column keeps the one-sided slope at
its block edges, because $-g_1x_1$ jumps at the periodic face and has no single-valued $P$; setup warns once. No
new figure: the stencils are those of @fig-ch06-dwork-stencil, whose panel (c) shows the one-sided seam slope of
the previous pin.

: Code map of where each form books its energy and where the logged sums are formed. {#tbl-ch06-conserves-code}

1. `from_yaml` sets `gravity_work` to `face` when the key is absent and `gravity_work_fixer` to true only for
   `cell` ([`const_gravity.cpp:28-36`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/9ad0936779ae001dba65c9eafccaa7c058686c97/src/forcing/const_gravity.cpp#L28-L36));
   the `HydroImpl` constructor forces `gravity_work_fixer` off for a face form
   ([`hydro.cpp:65`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/9ad0936779ae001dba65c9eafccaa7c058686c97/src/hydro/hydro.cpp#L65)).
2. `radial_exact_work` is true for `face`, $g_1\neq0$, the switch on, and a grid whose `x1_measure` is not
   `none`: Cartesian, spherical-polar or gnomonic-equiangle
   ([`hydro.cpp:268-273`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/9ad0936779ae001dba65c9eafccaa7c058686c97/src/hydro/hydro.cpp#L268-L273)).
   On another grid setup warns once in the `TORCH_WARN_ONCE` under `x1_measure`
   ([`hydro.cpp:101-106`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/9ad0936779ae001dba65c9eafccaa7c058686c97/src/hydro/hydro.cpp#L101-L106)),
   and with a periodic $x_1$ in the `TORCH_WARN_ONCE` under `periodic_x1`
   ([`hydro.cpp:91-95`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/9ad0936779ae001dba65c9eafccaa7c058686c97/src/hydro/hydro.cpp#L91-L95)).
3. Each stage, the corrected-PE term is added to the face work, by `corrected_pe_work` on a block with no $x_1$
   neighbour and by `corrected_pe_work_seam` with the neighbour's density change at a seam
   ([`hydro_forward.cpp:828-852`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/9ad0936779ae001dba65c9eafccaa7c058686c97/src/hydro/hydro_forward.cpp#L828-L852)).
4. With `cell`, `gwfix_stage` collects the stage defect for the fixer
   ([`hydro_forward.cpp:888-918`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/9ad0936779ae001dba65c9eafccaa7c058686c97/src/hydro/hydro_forward.cpp#L888-L918)),
   weighted by `cw` ([`hydro_forward.cpp:1015-1026`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/9ad0936779ae001dba65c9eafccaa7c058686c97/src/hydro/hydro_forward.cpp#L1015-L1026));
   otherwise `gravity_energy_correction` replaces the cell work, kept in the wall cells under `face-wallc`
   ([`hydro_forward.cpp:921-927`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/9ad0936779ae001dba65c9eafccaa7c058686c97/src/hydro/hydro_forward.cpp#L921-L927)).
5. After the last stage the fixer adds `efix` per unit mass and counts $-\mathcal D$ with `add_gravity_work_fix`
   ([`meshblock.cpp:906-910`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/9ad0936779ae001dba65c9eafccaa7c058686c97/src/mesh/meshblock.cpp#L906-L910)),
   committed when the step is accepted.
6. The cycle diagnostics sum `pe` as $\rho\phi$ at `x1v`, minus `corrected_pe_work_seam` of the density when
   `radial_exact_work` holds, into `pe_sum`
   ([`meshblock.cpp:1047-1060`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/9ad0936779ae001dba65c9eafccaa7c058686c97/src/mesh/meshblock.cpp#L1047-L1060)),
   print it as `pe=` ([`meshblock.cpp:1104`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/9ad0936779ae001dba65c9eafccaa7c058686c97/src/mesh/meshblock.cpp#L1104)),
   and print the run-to-date fixer energy `gravity_work_fix` as `fixgrav=` only when the fixer is on
   ([`meshblock.cpp:1113-1114`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/9ad0936779ae001dba65c9eafccaa7c058686c97/src/mesh/meshblock.cpp#L1113-L1114)).

So `pe=` is $P$ (with $\phi$ at the volume centroid on the cubed sphere) under the corrected-PE work and
$\mathrm{PE}_d$ under every other form. `fixgrav=` is the total energy the fixer has added over the run's
accepted steps, in J, not reduced per step and not carried across a restart; under `cell` + fixer, `ie=`+`pe=`
is constant and `fixgrav=` records how much heat that took.

| test (ctest name) | what it asserts | tolerance | where the tolerance comes from |
|---|---|---|---|
| `test_gravity_work_radial_exact_python` | per-step $E+P$, explicit and VIC, incl. `cs`, `cs_vic` | $10^{-14}$ rel. | `EP_TOL` |
| `test_gravity_work_radial_exact_python` | logged `ie=`+`pe=` equals $E+P$ (on), $E+\mathrm{PE}_d$ (off) | $10^{-11}$ | `DIAG_TOL` |
| `test_gravity_work_fixer_python` | `cell` + fixer keeps $E+\mathrm{PE}_d$; no fixer drifts | $10^{-12}$; $>100\times$ | `TOL` |
| `test_x1_seam_split_radial_exact` | 2 vs 1 $x_1$ blocks: gap 0, split $E+P$ drift | exact; $10^{-13}$ | the centred seam slope |
| `test_implicit_face_work_operator_python` | $E+\mathrm{PE}_d$ (switch 0) or $E+P$ under VIC | $10^{-11}$ rel. | `EPE_TOL` |

: Oracles of each form at snapy@9ad0936779ae001dba65c9eafccaa7c058686c97; assertions read from the test sources,
not run here. {#tbl-ch06-conserves-tests}

The corrected-PE oracle sets `EP_TOL` and `DIAG_TOL` at
[`test_gravity_work_radial_exact.py:55-56`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/9ad0936779ae001dba65c9eafccaa7c058686c97/tests/test_gravity_work_radial_exact.py#L55-L56)
and runs its cubed-sphere cases `cs` and `cs_vic`, one gnomonic-equiangle block with radial flow only, defined at
[`test_gravity_work_radial_exact.py:62`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/9ad0936779ae001dba65c9eafccaa7c058686c97/tests/test_gravity_work_radial_exact.py#L62).
The fixer oracle compares the drift with `TOL` in both directions at
[`test_gravity_work_fixer.py:204-207`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/9ad0936779ae001dba65c9eafccaa7c058686c97/tests/test_gravity_work_fixer.py#L204-L207);
its `cell` arms now state `cell`, since the default changed. The seam test requires a gap of exactly 0 with the
switch on and at most $10^{-13}$ with it off, in `radial_exact_split_gap`
([`test_x1_seam_split.cpp:255-275`](https://github.com/chengcli/snapy/blob/9ad0936779ae001dba65c9eafccaa7c058686c97/tests/test_x1_seam_split.cpp#L255-L275)).
`face-wallc` has no conservation oracle; `test_gravity_work_fixer` only reports its drift.

- Cubed sphere, six panels, flow across the panel seams, both $x_1$ walls closed, $E+P$ from the logged energy
  and `pe=`: per step $1.88\times10^{-15}$ explicit and $3.14\times10^{-15}$ VIC; with the centroid term left out

  snapy@546b1afd80d47a437a92ead745ef525f8335094a (PR head); deck/run: not stated in the body].
- $x_1$ seams, explicit: `radial_exact_split_gap` at $n_1$ = 32, 64, 128 went from $8.0\times10^{-7}$,
  $6.3\times10^{-8}$, $2.3\times10^{-9}$ to 0, and `test_pref_local_seam`, 4 blocks against 1, from a relative
  density difference of $2.7\times10^{-6}$ to $7\times10^{-15}$ [source: chengcli/snapy#303 body; sha:
  snapy@546b1afd80d47a437a92ead745ef525f8335094a (PR head); deck/run: ctest `test_x1_seam_split_radial_exact` and
  `test_pref_local_seam`, device not stated in the body].

Coverage: the six-panel $E+P$ numbers are measurements reported in the body; no ctest named in it asserts $E+P$
on six panels. CUDA and several-rank coverage are as in @sec-ch06-dwork.

### Limits

::: {.callout-warning title="Limits"}
On a default run (`face`, switch on) every $E+\mathrm{PE}_d$ check, including `gravity_work_defect()`, measures
the wrong invariant: check `ie=`+`pe=`. `fixgrav=` is printed only with `cell` + fixer.
:::

- `cell` without the fixer and `face-wallc` have no exact energy invariant; neither has an oracle that bounds the
  drift.
- Periodic $x_1$: the corrected-PE work keeps the one-sided slope at block edges and $P$ is not defined; setup
  warns once. The fixer refuses periodic and open $x_1$.
- An implicit scheme refuses any $x_1$ split, so implicit runs have no seam case to test.
- VIC wall cells of the corrected-PE work are about second order, not fourth: the implicit correction flux is
  first-order upwind and $O(\Delta t)$ (chengcli/snapy#302); conservation is unaffected.
- A lone gnomonic block with reflecting lateral walls loses mass under lateral flow, switch on or off
  (chengcli/snapy#301); the single-block ctest uses radial flow only.
- Grids other than Cartesian, spherical-polar and gnomonic-equiangle keep the plain face form and $E+\mathrm{PE}_d$.
- Untested combinations: @sec-ch12-matrix.
